editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. The meaning matches the English throughout, including the NP-hard and stochastic SabreSwap caveats, the "up to six CNOT" claim and the "only run if explicitly called" condition for scheduling. The stage headings are inconsistent: "Étape init", "Étape layout", "Étape routing" and "Étape translation" keep the English name, but "Étape d'optimisation" is translated. Body text says "placement"/"routage" in some places and "Layout"/"Routing" in others. There are also a few calques and anglicisms: "À haut niveau" in [64], "le timing du circuit" in [68] and "mappe naïvement" in [23]. In [30], "many times" became "plusieurs fois", which is slightly weaker.

examples.suggested: Étape de traduction (ou garder un seul style pour tous les titres, en cohérence avec « Étape d'optimisation »)
examples.why: The headings mix styles. Some keep the English stage name and one is translated, and "translation" is a false friend in French.

examples.source: At a high level, the scheduling pass can be thought of as...
examples.translation: À haut niveau, la passe de scheduling peut être vue comme...
examples.suggested: Schématiquement, la passe de scheduling peut être vue comme...
examples.why: "À haut niveau" is a calque of "at a high level" and does not read as idiomatic French.

examples.source: To get a better idea of the timing of the circuit
examples.translation: Pour mieux comprendre le timing du circuit
examples.suggested: Pour mieux visualiser la chronologie (le minutage) du circuit
examples.why: "timing" is an unnecessary anglicism when ordinary French terms exist.

examples.source: run the routing function ... many times
examples.translation: exécuter la fonction de routage ... plusieurs fois
examples.suggested: exécuter la fonction de routage ... de nombreuses fois
examples.why: "plusieurs fois" is a little weaker than "many times". This is a minor nuance, not a misleading error.

editor_note: The translation is faithful, natural and uses "tu" throughout. It renders the terms correctly ("matrices densité", "canaux", "mesures générales"), and entry [9] keeps the operational link between distance/similarity, channels and measurements ("se rattachent, sur le plan opérationnel").

The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing would mislead a learner. The problems are consistency and a few calques. Hamiltonian is written "hamiltonien" up to [127] and "Hamiltonien" from [128] on, with mixed elision ("de l'hamiltonien" next to "du Hamiltonien"). Basis set moves between "ensemble de base", "base" and "ensemble de bases". Mapping is "correspondance" in [86]-[87] but "mapping/mappé" from [128]. Expectation value is "valeur d'espérance" everywhere except [177], which uses "valeurs d'attente", and that entry also renders "initial point to fit the Hamiltonian" as "pour ajuster l'hamiltonien", which reads as if the Hamiltonian were being tuned. Smaller slips: "a la chance de révolutionner" ([73]) is a calque, "atténuation" alternates with "mitigation" ([209]), and the "Check your understanding" heading alternates between "Teste" and "Vérifie ta compréhension".

examples.source: we will use the appropriate initial point to fit the Hamiltonian ... calculate the Hamiltonian's expectations
examples.translation: nous utiliserons le point initial approprié pour ajuster l'hamiltonien ... calculer les valeurs d'attente de l'hamiltonien
examples.suggested: nous utiliserons un point initial adapté à cet hamiltonien ... calculer les valeurs d'espérance de l'hamiltonien
examples.why: 'ajuster l'hamiltonien' suggests the Hamiltonian itself is being modified. 'valeurs d'attente' is a calque and breaks the file's own 'valeur d'espérance'.

examples.source: defining the Hamiltonian ... applying the Jordan-Wigner mapping
examples.translation: en définissant l'Hamiltonien ... application du mapping Jordan-Wigner
examples.suggested: en définissant l'hamiltonien ... application de la transformation de Jordan-Wigner
examples.why: Earlier entries ([19], [87]) use lowercase 'hamiltonien' and 'correspondance de Jordan-Wigner'. From here on the file switches to 'Hamiltonien' and 'mapping', so the same term appears in two forms.

examples.source: the change in the set of bases used in calculating the Hamiltonian
examples.translation: le changement de l'ensemble de bases utilisé dans le calcul de l'Hamiltonien
examples.suggested: le changement d'ensemble de base utilisé pour calculer l'hamiltonien
examples.why: Basis set is 'ensemble de base' in [13]-[28] but 'ensemble de bases' or plain 'base' later ([172], [206], [217]). This is inconsistent, though the concept stays recognizable.

examples.source: Quantum computing has a chance to revolutionize chemistry
examples.translation: L'informatique quantique a la chance de révolutionner la chimie
examples.suggested: L'informatique quantique pourrait révolutionner la chimie
examples.why: 'avoir la chance de' means 'to be lucky enough to', so this is a calque. In the same entry, 'a célèbrement noté' is also stiff.

examples.translation: les ansätze efficaces pour le matériel ont des circuits plus courts
examples.suggested: les ansätze efficaces pour le matériel ont des circuits moins profonds
examples.why: Circuit depth is the established notion ('circuits profonds' appears in the same sentence). 'plus courts' loses the contrast with 'profonds'.
